summary: PROMPT 05 Stripe TEST/Sandbox adapter verified. Ran existing test_stripe_provider.py (11 tests) and added test_prompt05_regressions.py (9 tests) covering ledger absence on failed Stripe payments, mock provider regression (single credit), POST /api/providers live-mode rejection, provider discovery invariants, idempotency-before-dispatch, public Stripe webhook (unmatched + ignored event types), and auth/RBAC regression. Full backend suite: 95/95 passed serially.
critical_code_review_comments: registry.py registers a single global StripeProvider instance at import — env changes require process restart (acceptable but worth noting).
webhooks.py /stripe uses can_transition then validate_transition — slight duplication; can_transition alone would suffice with try/except.
StripeProvider.charge silently swallows all exceptions with type(exc).__name__ — good for graceful degradation but consider logging exc details at debug level for troubleshooting.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed payments for stripe (failed) and mock (succeeded) against acme tenant; ledger entries persist but are correctly scoped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Stripe adapter fully wired in TEST mode. Run tests with `cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/ -n0 -q`. MUST use -n0 (webhook race in xdist). Placeholder sk_test_emergent key causes real Stripe calls to fail gracefully — this is expected. Ledger schema uses `ref_id`+`direction` (not payment_id/side).
